Oxford DELUXE 3 Speed City Bikes
DELUXE edition adds special cup holder + Custom Color Matched rear rack. Classic, Stylish design. Low-maintenance Shimano Nexus 3 speed internal gears. Super-efficient road-worthy tires; wide enough for softening most town bumps. Components and geometry with a most comfy position. Cruise on campus, town or neighborhood. Finely Hand Crafted of durable, comfortable 4130 CroMo Steel. Stylish custom color matched fenders and chain-guard. Brown stitched grips and matching saddle.
